Palm is a must in HP
Sep 2026 • Family
Honestly really impressed with this place

If you’re in HP and want somewhere nice to eat then definitely recommend Palm

Food was really good, place is beautiful and the staff were super attentive too

The whole place kinda feels like you’re at a resort 😂 really chill, sit there eating drinking and honestly just don’t wanna leave

The steak though... so good

Super tender, juicy, almost melts in your mouth. Asked the staff why it was so soft and they said the beef is aged so yeah that probably explains it

And the beer here is sooo good 😂 properly ice cold, like really really cold. Sounds like a small thing but I drink beer quite a lot and honestly not many places get it like this. Hits so good

Apparently they have dozens of beers but I only tried 5 lol

Next time I come back I’m definitely trying more

Overall the vibe is just really good, food is good, drinks are good, staff are nice and yeah definitely worth the money

I’m usually way too lazy to leave reviews 😂 but they did such a good job here so had to give them some support

Incredible food and a top craft beer selection!
Jun 2026 • Friends
The Palm is one of my absolute favorite restaurants in Hai Phong!

From the hand-built, wood-burning pizza oven to a massive lineup of local Vietnamese craft beers on tap, you can tell they don't cut corners on quality. The chef is a master at pairing premium imported ingredients with fresh local sourcing. The price is more than equal to the value you receive from both the food and the service.

The space itself is stunningly designed! In cooler weather, I enjoy working remotely at a table outside, but it’s also perfect for anything from a casual night out with friends to a business dinner or a special celebration. What really draws me back, though, are the monthly "social dining" events...they are a total blast and have really brought the community together.

If you haven't been yet, you're missing out on one of the finest dining experiences in Hai Phong.

Cheers to Trang and her Team for creating such a standout spot!

Insider tip:
My go-to is the pizza paired with a craft brew. =)

Dang Tien N
Thank you, Jack

Your review really made our day.

Bringing Modern Mediterranean flavors to Hai Phong with a genuine Social dining vibe—around the wood-burning oven and craft beers—was always our ultimate goal. Knowing you caught on to those details means a lot to us.

Our monthly Social Night is the team's favorite moment. It’s our chance to share the hidden effort and stories behind each dish over a curated tasting flow. Seeing everyone connect out by the pool makes it all worth it.

Glad to be your go-to spot, whether to work quietly or for a night out. 

See you soon for another cold beer!
